brief.prompt:
Use case: illustration-story
Asset type: Japanese basketball editorial website thumbnail, one finished landscape PNG, approximately 16:9, ideally 1672x940 or 1600x900 and at least 1000px wide.

Create ONE bold hand-inked basketball editorial illustration with Japanese typography, following the approved black-and-lime style reference visible in this conversation. Background deep charcoal #151A18; fluorescent lime #CCF43B broad dry brush sweeps and subtle ink flecks; ivory text and grayscale ink figure; orange basketball accent. Clearly drawn illustration, not photography, not photorealistic. Few elements and very strong small-screen hierarchy.

Article facts, exclusively from the supplied fixed manuscript: Sendai beat Alvark Tokyo 96-69 on November 6 and moved into first place in the Eastern district; article dated 2026.11.07. Only the exact team-result copy below may appear. Do not imply this selected player scored, participated in, or determined this game.

Subject: exactly ONE real player, Shota Watanabe / 渡辺翔太, randomly selected from Sendai's current official roster because the manuscript names no players. Match the official portrait just inspected in this conversation: young adult Japanese man with short, slightly spiky dark brown-black hair above a broad plain black headband, a few irregular upward strands and short sides; clean-shaven oval face tapering to a fairly compact rounded chin; straight dark eyebrows, dark almond-shaped eyes, straight nose and gently closed medium lips. Lean compact muscular point-guard build. Preserve recognizable hair, headband, face shape, eyes and mouth in crisp expressive black/ivory ink shading, with sufficient lit facial detail. The reference photo is for likeness only; redraw completely. Plain sleeveless ivory basketball jersey with small lime edge accents, plain dark shorts, generic unbranded shoes, plain headband. Absolutely no logos, sponsor marks, jersey lettering, name or jersey number.

Composition: large stacked headline on the LEFT, roughly 55% of the frame, with generous negative space. On the RIGHT, the player in an energetic low driving dribble, bent knees, forward leaning torso, three-quarter front face visible, right hand naturally controlling one orange basketball at hip-to-knee level, left arm bent naturally for balance. Show full figure and both shoes within the frame. Clear anatomically coherent hands and limbs, one ball only, no duplicated fingers, no cut-off ball, no extra players. Use a fresh low diagonal driving composition, NOT the upright shooting pose from the style sample. Abstract brush background only, no exact arena, crowd or identifiable game moment. This is a conceptual illustration, never a reconstruction of the reported match.

Text, verbatim and only these strings:
Top left small brand: "バスケまとめ"
Below brand small date: "2026.11.07"
Main headline, huge ivory first line: "仙台"
Main headline, large lime second line: "東地区首位へ"
Lower-left score line in bold ivory: "仙台 96-69 A東京"
Bottom footer legible ivory: "イラスト（AI生成）"
Beside footer: "イメージ"

Typeface: thick Japanese gothic with an editorial brush texture, precise clean kanji and numerals. All text fully inside canvas with at least 5% edge margin. Keep player face, hand and ball off the text. Footer must be easily legible and unbroken. Do not copy the style example's player name, 38 points, Kobe score, old date, or qualifier. Do not put Watanabe's name or any individual performance text anywhere. No B.LEAGUE or team logos. Generate the finished art and typography together.

generator.qa_method: 内蔵生成結果の実画像を目視検品し、sipsでPNG形式と寸法を確認。文字・数字、チームに限った結果表現、イメージ注記、容姿、手足・ボール・見切れ、AI生成表記を確認。レタリングの空白幅は意匠上の差で意味は同一。画像内容の後処理なし。
generator.scope: ローカルのgenerated.pngとbrief.jsonの保存のみ。ready実行・git操作・公開・外部送信なし。
